models_evaluated: fully automated deep learning-based vestibular schwannoma volume measurement

links.outcome: Effect of AI volume measures on radiological classification and management decisions in simulated MDMs
links.effect: AI volumes changed radiological classification of size change (z=2.49, P=.01) but not management decisions (z=0.30, P=.76) versus linear measures.
links.quote: Provision of fully automated VS volume measurements to "real-world" MDM preparation significantly impacted the radiological classification of VS size change but did not influence management decisions.

screen.reason: Evaluates simulated multidisciplinary team meetings comparing standard manual linear tumor measures versus AI-provided fully automated volumetric measures on clinical decision-making.

primary.practice: automated volumetric measurement assistance in multidisciplinary meeting preparation
